candidates.file: Westland landscapes feat. Fox Glacier - Te Moeka o Tuawe - WestlandLandscapes10042.jpg
candidates.reason: Commons categories Fox Glacier, Southern Alps, Westland Tai Poutini NP; coords at Fox Glacier. Glacier between valley walls under snowy peaks, blue sky, 4:3, 4341px, CC0, recent. Foreground walls in shadow but the subject is centred and striking.

candidates.file: Southern Alps from Douglas Peak to Mount Cook in morning light.jpg
candidates.reason: Real photo inside the park (Okarito Trig, 2024) but a telephoto strip of distant snowy ridge above dark forest with a big empty sky; undramatic, and the glaciers themselves are not seen.

candidates.file: Podocarp forest in Westland Tai Poutini National Park along West Coast bordered by Southern Alps.jpg
candidates.reason: Hazy view over bushy foreground and forest; Alps are a faint thin strip at far left. Flat, not spectacular.

candidates.file: View from West Coast to Southern Alps in evening sunlight (Fox Glacier, Mount Tasman, Mount Cook).jpg
candidates.reason: Taken from farmland at Te Kopikopiko o te Waka, outside the park; foreground is pasture with cows and fence posts, peaks small and distant.
Genuine park photo of the Fox River valley with bare gravel bed and cloud, but no glacier or alpine peaks; pleasant but flat and not the park's defining sight.
Current. Featured picture of Franz Josef Glacier, 2000x2000, 2011, glacier valley with blue sky. Good photo but it is the same file used for the Franz Josef Glacier spot, so use it only there.

header.choice: Westland landscapes feat. Fox Glacier - Te Moeka o Tuawe - WestlandLandscapes10042.jpg

candidates.reason: Franz Josef valley but the glacier is almost wholly hidden in cloud; the visible subject is the gravel valley and rock walls.
Walkers on the valley path under cloud; the glacier is a tiny sliver in the distance, so a visitor would not see the glacier.
Real icefall at Franz Josef but grey, overcast and murky under low cloud; recognisable as ice only, flat and uninviting next to the current photo.
Portrait view up the valley; glacier is pale and washed out in mist with the peaks obscured. Weak at thumbnail size.
Current. Featured/quality image of Franz Josef Glacier, 2011, colour, clear blue sky, ice tumbling down a valley, subject centred; clearly the best of the set.

candidates.file: Fox Glacier in Westland National Park 07.jpg
candidates.reason: Categories Fox Glacier / Te Moeka o Tuawe, quality image 2017, coords at Fox Glacier. Terminus icefall in a valley with blue sky and cloud, 3787px. Moraine-grey but clearly a glacier and recognisable at thumbnail size.

candidates.file: Fox Glacier in Westland National Park 04.jpg
candidates.reason: Tight crop of the grey moraine-covered terminus with cloud; less context and less clear ice than 07.

candidates.file: Fox Glacier in Westland National Park 06.jpg
candidates.reason: Closer, grey crop of the same terminus under thick cloud; murky, ice hard to read.

candidates.file: Fox Glacier in Westland National Park 01.jpg
candidates.reason: Fox Glacier terminus in valley with blue sky and cloud, quality image, 3195px. Acceptable but very similar to 07 and slightly less sharp in the ice.

candidates.file: Fox Glacier in Westland National Park 08.jpg
candidates.reason: Glacier is only a small distant sliver; the picture is mostly rubble slopes and valley.
Current. Dramatic aerial-style view of Fox Glacier, but only 600px wide (fails the 960 spot minimum), a 1986 scan with film grain and a muted look, and it is an old slide.
